targets.rawSql:
WITH instrument_times AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT time FROM data WHERE instrument_id = $instrument ORDER BY time ASC LIMIT 1) AS oldest_data,
    (SELECT time FROM data WHERE instrument_id = $instrument ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_data
)

SELECT i.name AS "Name",
       i.serial AS "D-number",
       i.model AS "Model",
       i.server AS "Server IP",
       i.ds_version AS "Data services",
       it.oldest_data AS "Oldest data",
       it.latest_data AS "Latest data" 
FROM instruments i 
LEFT JOIN instrument_times it ON TRUE
WHERE i.id = $instrument

SELECT
  'xT server' AS name,
  CASE value_num
    WHEN 1 THEN 'Up'
    WHEN 0 THEN 'Down'
  END AS value_num,
  time
FROM
  data
WHERE
  instrument_id = $instrument
  AND param_id = $param_id_server
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY
  time DESC
LIMIT
  1

WITH target_param AS (
  SELECT param_id, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument AND param_id = $param_id_water
)


SELECT
  'Water cooling' AS name,
  ev.member_name AS value_num,
  d.time
FROM
  data d
JOIN target_param tp ON tp.param_id = d.param_id
JOIN enum_values ev ON ev.enum_id = tp.enum_id
WHERE
  d.instrument_id = $instrument
  AND d.param_id = $param_id_water
  AND $__timeFilter(d.time)
  AND d.value_num = ev.value
ORDER BY
  d.time DESC
LIMIT
  1

WITH target_params AS (
  SELECT 
    substring(param_name FROM 's\.(.+)$') AS component,
    param_id, enum_id
  FROM parameters
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND component = 'SystemStatus'
    AND (param_name LIKE 'Detectors.%' OR param_name LIKE 'Imaging_devices.%')
),
latest_data AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (param_id) *
  FROM data
  WHERE instrument_id = $instrument
    AND param_id IN (SELECT param_id FROM target_params)
    AND $__timeFilter(time)
  ORDER BY param_id, time DESC
)
SELECT
  'Detector: ' || tp.component AS name,
  ev.member_name AS value_num,
  ld.time
FROM target_params tp
JOIN latest_data ld
  ON ld.param_id = tp.param_id
JOIN enum_values ev
  ON ev.enum_id = tp.enum_id
  AND ld.value_num = ev.value
ORDER BY ld.time DESC;
